scope: Implementation tests; no Cloud Run deployment or live shared library changes. Real-model smoke uses isolated synthetic memory data.

initial_findings.issue: Final ADK transcripts were appended to partial fragments, duplicating speech text; interrupted/tool-only completions advanced the interview prematurely.
initial_findings.resolution: Full transcripts replace partial buffers; only actual, non-interrupted assistant replies complete the turn. Deterministic red/green regression and real-model recheck pass.

initial_findings.issue: An initial downstream analysis used status Completed instead of the stored lowercase completed.
initial_findings.resolution: Preserve exact provided code/category literals; real-model smoke supplies the actual enum. The initial observation is retained in voice-skill-author-live-initial.json. Generated skills require review.

initial_findings.issue: Scrollable draft preview lacked keyboard access.
initial_findings.resolution: Focusable preview and visible focus ring added; final browser audit recorded separately.

limitations: Real Live checks inject text and receive audio; microphone hardware and manual screen-reader checks remain manual.
